rationale: This condition establishes the operational definitions and measurement access needed to run the fixed checkpoint classification procedure. Verifying timestamp meanings is ordinary measurement setup; identifying unavailable checkpoints determines which probes can run and the resolution reported. It adds no independent evidential bridge or change to the retained target.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: For the fixed case type and cohort, document checkpoint allowances, verify which events timestamps represent, and confirm that elapsed times can be recovered or logged. Mark unobservable checkpoints and retain a wider reported interval where necessary.
